highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.157.0 brings Skia m157 with fixes for rasterization, text, image filtering and GPU rendering.
highlights_body: The stable release adds mask-filtered glyph corrections and tighter image-subset sampling to the fixes delivered in previews. Generated LibraryImport bindings now explicitly use cdecl, including in HarfBuzzSharp.

breaking.title: Check Graphite Metal deployment targets
breaking.body: The native Graphite Metal backend now requires iOS or tvOS 15; its macOS minimum remains 12. If using this backend, raise older deployment targets accordingly. These native minimums do not lower any higher requirements imposed by managed packages or frameworks.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to Skia m157. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.200 while retaining native HarfBuzz 14.4.0.

Fixes a convex anti-aliased path heap overflow across vertical clip gaps, coverage-mask clamping and convex-path bounds. Validates direct-mask glyph replay and corrects mask-filtered glyph reloads, incompatible mask copies and clipped embossed-glyph planes.
Corrects reflected zero-length hairline square caps, transformed ellipse and rounded-rectangle geometry, text-atlas selection and stale atlas work after empty Ganesh flushes.

Prevents unrelated backing-texture pixels from leaking into image subsets under minification, skew, anti-aliased clipping and MSAA. Aligns displacement-offset precision with filter bounds and image-filter cache equality with hashing.

Fixes clip-key packing, wedge inflation and alpha-to-RGBx GPU readback stride. Clip draws now count toward render-pass capacity; a draw whose full clip stack cannot fit is warned about and skipped rather than exceeding capacity.

Fixes render-pass pointer initialization and adds a targeted device-loss cleanup delay for ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers from version 42 through 55. Native synchronous submission now accounts for fence-wait failures; managed GRContext.Submit remains void and exposes no new failure result.

Generated LibraryImport declarations now match the cdecl convention used by DllImport and delegates, addressing a calling-convention mismatch relevant to Windows x86. Runtime validation of the reported optimized-call stack-growth symptom remains outstanding.

preview_summaries.v4.157.0-rc.2.26563.19: Release Candidate 2 corrected transformed Ganesh geometry, stale atlas work and Graphite clip-capacity accounting. It also improved displacement-filter precision and native synchronous Vulkan wait handling without adding a managed submission result.
preview_summaries.v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6: Release Candidate 1 corrected reflected hairline square caps and GPU text-atlas selection. It also added a device-loss cleanup delay for affected ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers.
preview_summaries.v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1: Preview 1 introduced Skia m157 with rasterization, glyph-replay and Graphite clipping and readback fixes, plus explicit cdecl LibraryImport bindings. Graphite Metal adopted the native iOS/tvOS 15 minimum; HarfBuzzSharp moved to package revision 14.4.0.200 without changing native HarfBuzz 14.4.0.

harfbuzz_summary: Generated HarfBuzzSharp LibraryImport declarations now explicitly select cdecl, matching the existing DllImport and delegate paths without changing public APIs or native exports.

v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1.headline: Preview 1 brings Skia m157 with rasterization, glyph-replay and Graphite readback fixes.
v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1.body: LibraryImport declarations explicitly select cdecl. HarfBuzzSharp package revision 14.4.0.200 retains native HarfBuzz 14.4.0. Graphite Metal requires iOS or tvOS 15, in addition to any higher framework requirements.

v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6.headline: Release Candidate 1 corrects reflected hairline caps and GPU text-atlas selection.
v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6.body: It also adds a targeted device-loss cleanup delay for affected ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers. These fixes do not change managed APIs.

v4.157.0-rc.2.26563.19.headline: Release Candidate 2 improves transformed GPU geometry, Graphite clipping and displacement-filter precision.
v4.157.0-rc.2.26563.19.body: It also corrects stale Ganesh atlas work and native synchronous Vulkan wait handling. GRContext.Submit remains void; no managed failure-reporting result is added.

v4.157.0.headline: Stable 4.157.0 corrects mask-filtered glyph rendering and filtered image subsets.
v4.157.0.body: It also aligns image-filter cache equality with hashing. These final fixes do not change managed APIs.
